purpose: Independent dialect resource discovery for existing DAL, not a change to thesis architecture or original evaluation; new linked lexical and dialect tools are recorded by task and source-license status; Lahga is recorded as a dialect-form candidate source, not as gold ANHC labels or narrative text.

datasets.data: 2k parallel sentences across 25 city dialects; further 12k for five cities
limits: mostly short travel-related sentences, not narrative stories
license research/evaluation internal only; disallows redistribution and alteration
Amman, Salt, Alexandria, Cairo and Fes among 25; Aqaba-specific absent
heldout benchmark must not be used for training

datasets.data: Dialect identification shared tasks, variable editions/country/province granularity
limits: access may require registration
tweets or short texts, not literary narratives
license varies by edition
short social texts not full stories
verify data license before training or redistribution

datasets.data: about 25k dialect-annotated tweets across Egyptian, Maghrebi, Levantine, Gulf, Iraqi
limits: not a movie screenplay dataset
review original distribution terms

datasets.data: 30k+ copyrighted song lyrics annotated across 6 dialect families
limits: music lyrics, not folktales
distribution for research is not blanket permission for model-training redistribution
not recommended for storytelling fine-tuning

datasets.data: Parallel Arabic dialect corpus, referenced by Arabic NLP Observatory
limits: access, license, splits and variants require verification

datasets.data: catalogue with >1,100 dataset entries as observed November 2026
limits: catalogue license differs from each linked dataset's rights
not itself a training corpus

datasets.data: user-generated fiction, novels and dialect dialogue
limits: individual authors own works; do not scrape, upload, or train on them without appropriate permission
cannot conflate modern copyrighted works with public-domain heritage

datasets.data: Unverified under exact name as a long-form licensed narrative corpus
limits: request original DOI/repository and license before any use

datasets.data: Egyptian segmentation resource; four-dialect segmentation resource; and four-dialect POS resource with 350 manually segmented/POS-tagged tweets per dialect (Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, Maghrebi)
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 stated by QCRI resource page
limits: tweet-level data, not narratives
keep all official benchmark/test folds out of ANHC story training
cite Darwish et al. (2018); preserve Apache-2.0 notice
download-specific terms and file integrity still to be recorded

datasets.data: XML lexical verb classes with Arabic members, roots, deverbal forms, participles, syntactic frames, semantic roles/predicates, and example sentences
limits: not a story corpus or dialect-labeled resource
check license and schema before copying or integrating
example sentences should not be counted as ANHC narratives

datasets.data: Classifier project and aggregated sentence-level data reported from arabic_pos_dialect, IADD, QADI, MADAR, plus 10,000 Wikipedia MSA sentences
limits: mixed data provenance; resolve each constituent license independently
do not import as story text or ANHC gold labels
avoid training on source benchmark test partitions
published README metrics are project-reported and require reproduction before comparison

datasets.data: 2,012 MSA headwords; 25,072 dialect forms; 3,313 example sentences; 24 varieties
limits: 3,606 of 25,072 forms are flagged needs_review; the card says over half of forms were first model-drafted
needs_review=false does not mean confirmed by a native speaker
coverage is uneven; the card reports only 25 Jordanian forms and 1,123 Yemeni forms
the source requests attribution and share-alike for derivatives and says models trained on it should follow the same licence
lexical resource, not a narrative formula/story corpus; no transliteration and no dialect verb paradigms
datasets.admission: candidate_only; human validation and licence-compatible release policy required

research_gates: Never add retrieved dataset text to GitHub without confirmed rights
Keep existing ANSG thesis original data and metric provenance unchanged
Use separate dialect-specific validated partitions for DAL; never mix official test with training
For Jordanian dialect, Amman/Salt is not Aqaba dialect; require a local-speech source or native-speaker evaluation
Measure authenticity with human dialect speakers, not just marker word frequency
Document source name, dialect granularity, licence, splits, record genre and hash
